The '''''Spice Siren''''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] that was active during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="Annual">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]'' places events before the story in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].</ref> the ship went missing in the [[Tatoo system/Legends|Tatooine system]] in a suspected act of [[Pirate/Legends|piracy]]. At the time, the ship was carrying munitions. [[Breakout Squad]], led by [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commander]] [[Nuru Kungurama]], was sent to investigate.<ref name="TCWSM4" /> [[Standard year/Legends|Years]] later, [[Biggs Darklighter/Legends|Biggs Darklighter]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] once shot down numerous, large [[Womp rat/Legends|womp rats]] from the safety of Biggs's [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] near the crashed ''Spice Siren'' in the [[Xelric Draw/Legends|Xelric Draw]].<ref name="Life and Times">''[[A New Hope: The Life of Luke Skywalker]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
''Spice Siren'' appears in the [[2009]] young readers book ''[[A New Hope: The Life of Luke Skywalker]]'', and is mentioned in the [[2004]] reference book ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars Trilogy]]'' and the [[2012]] novel ''[[The Clone Wars: Secret Missions 4: Guardians of the Chiss Key]]''.
